text:
aj: Thinking out loud — we should re-evaluate how retry budgets interact with per-tenant ingress rate isolation when streaming is on. Observed a tenant blow through retries and starve others.

tara: yep saw that in the canary yesterday, two long-running streams + aggressive client retries = queue pileup.

sam: is this about hedging or plain retry backoff misconfig?

aj: mix of both. Hedging spawns duplicate midflight requests; our current retry budget counts hedges + retries against the same tenant bucket. That means a noisy client can exhaust budget and block healthy short requests.

lina: proposal: separate budgets for streaming sessions vs control-plane requests. streaming_budget and control_budget. Streaming gets a smaller concurrent slot count but unlimited lightweight prefix retries?

maria: small +1 for separate budgets. Also need a different retry-window semantics: streaming should use checkpointed idempotency tokens instead of naive retry window.

aj: Agreed. Implementation sketch:
```
route: /v1/streaming/*
  admission: tenant_stream_slots: 8
  retry_policy:
    hedge_allowed: true
    hedge_burst: 1
    streaming_retry_window_ms: 1500
route: /v1/*
  admission: tenant_control_slots: 64
  retry_policy: default_retry_window_ms: 3000
```

tara: question: how do we account for KV cache/kv-prefixing? if we resume a streaming request we may re-use KV cache and it shouldn't count as full-cost retry.

sam: maybe track resume_vs_restart flag on the admission ticket. resume -> discounted budget charge. restart -> full charge. Tickets have fields: {tenant, type, charge_weight}.

aj: good call. That would let us transparently handle midstream resumption without overcharging tenant quota.

infra-bot: deploy-queue: canary rollout queued for config: ingress-retry-budgets (sha: c4f2). scheduled in 15m.

maria: ops note — need dashboard metrics before rollout: tenant_retry_charge, resume_discount_rate, slot_saturation. Otherwise we can't verify the change.

tara: also add alert: tenant_slot_starvation if a tenant sees >=80% blocked short-control requests for >30s.

aj: next steps: (1) PR with config shape + ticket instrumentation, (2) small canary on eu-west only, (3) collect metrics for 24h, (4) iterate. I can open the PR this afternoon.

lina: thanks — ping me on the PR for gating the hedging flags. Might need a separate feature flag per-route.

sam: FYI, this also affects Dedicated runtime where slot counts map to GPU worker queues. We'll need a mapping document for capacity planning.

maria: I'll add the dashboard seats. If anyone wants pre-reqs for the PR let me know.

aj: awesome, I'll draft the PR and link here. :thumbsup:
